name: Bella Terra
summary: Bella Terra is a laid-back, open-air lifestyle center in Huntington Beach featuring big-box stores, casual restaurants, bars, and a Century Theatres movie complex. This popular destination combines shopping, dining, and entertainment in a relaxed outdoor setting that reflects the coastal Southern California lifestyle.
demographics: Bella Terra attracts an affluent, family-oriented demographic from Huntington Beach and surrounding Orange County communities, with visitors typically in the 25-54 age range and above-average household incomes. The trade area draws from coastal Orange County residents who value convenience and outdoor shopping experiences, including young professionals, established families, and active retirees. Shopping patterns reflect a preference for casual dining, entertainment options like the Century Theatres, and a mix of national retailers and specialty stores in an open-air environment.
description: Bella Terra is a premier open-air lifestyle center located in the heart of Huntington Beach, California, offering a distinctive shopping and entertainment experience just minutes from the Pacific Coast. Spanning a thoughtfully designed outdoor environment, this vibrant destination combines big-box retailers, specialty shops, and an impressive array of casual dining options and bars that create a relaxed, Southern California atmosphere. The center features Century Theatres as a major entertainment anchor, providing moviegoers with the latest films in a modern setting. Whether visitors are enjoying an afternoon with family, a romantic evening out, or simply meeting friends for a meal, Bella Terra serves as a community gathering place that reflects the laid-back coastal lifestyle of Huntington Beach. With convenient hours Monday through Saturday from 10:00 AM to 9:00 PM and Sunday from 11:00 AM to 6:00 PM, the center regularly hosts seasonal events and wellness activities, including their "Bella Terra Takes a Bite Out of Hunger" community initiative and winter shopping experiences that enhance the visitor experience throughout the year.
